releases.notes:
- **Fixed the Submit button on Prepare Trip staying grey after picking a
  schedule.** Submit needs both a bus and a schedule, and your bus is normally
  filled in for you — so when that failed, the sheet looked like it only needed
  a schedule and the grey button looked broken. It now says "Choose a bus to
  continue" under the bus box, and your own bus is always there to pick even if
  the app's copy of the bus list is out of date. Restarting the phone is no
  longer the way out of this.

- **The app now shows a bar at the top while the walkthrough is running.** It
  reminds you that the trips, buses and students you are seeing are practice
  data and that nothing is sent to parents. The bar has a Stop button, so you
  can leave the walkthrough from any screen, at any point, without being sent
  back to the home screen.

- **The walkthrough no longer gets stuck part way through.** If a step could
  not find the button it was pointing at, the guide used to vanish without
  actually ending — leaving the app showing practice data instead of your real
  trips, with nothing on screen to say so, until the phone was restarted. It
  now stops properly and tells you. If demo mode is ever still on when it
  should not be, the bar at the top turns red and says the data is not real.

- **The bus stays on the map for the whole route.** Live tracking could stop
  part way through a trip and never come back, with nothing on the phone to say
  it had — the app looked fine from the driver's seat while the bus vanished
  from the school's map. Several separate causes are fixed: moving between the
  school's Wi-Fi and mobile data, the phone shutting the app down in the
  background during a long route, and driving through a tunnel or a dead spot,
  which used to leave a hole in the route instead of filling it in afterwards.

- **You are told if tracking does not start.** Starting a pickup whose tracking
  failed to start used to run the entire route untracked without a word. It now
  says so on screen, and the trip still starts — parents have already been
  texted that the bus is on its way, so nothing is cancelled.

- **If location is switched off on the phone, the app says so before you set
  off.** You get the choice of opening the phone's settings to turn it back on,
  or starting the trip anyway. Either way the trip starts — this is a warning,
  not a lock. With location off there is no tracking at all for the whole route,
  which is why it is worth stopping for.

- **The bus reports its position the moment you press Start**, rather than up to
  fifteen seconds later, so it appears on the map straight away instead of
  seeming not to have left.

- **A phone set up from another phone's backup no longer breaks tracking on
  both.** Two handsets restored from the same backup could quietly knock each
  other off tracking, each one reporting itself as healthy.

- **Fixes version 1.4.0, which would not start on most phones.** That update
  was built for one type of phone processor and crashed immediately on every
  other, before the app was far enough along to offer an update out of it. If
  your app stopped opening after updating to 1.4.0, install this version by
  hand from the releases page — the app cannot repair itself once it is in that
  state. Everything new in 1.4.0 is here and unchanged.

- **The scanner starts reliably when you open a roll call.** Opening the roll
  call straight after another screen that had been scanning could leave the
  reader dead for the whole roll call — tags simply did nothing, and the only
  way out was to back out of the screen and open it again. Fixed.

- **Children reported absent now show on the roll call.** If a parent or the
  school has already phoned a child in as absent, they appear on the scan roll
  call marked as such, with who reported it and when — instead of sitting in
  the list looking exactly like a child you have not scanned yet. They also
  come out of the "X of Y scanned" count, so the count reaches the end when the
  roll call is actually finished. If the child turns up anyway, scan their tag
  as normal and they move across.

- **Changing your bus now shows on the Home screen straight away.** Picking a
  different bus in Profile used to leave the old number plate on the Home
  header until the app was restarted.

- **The running trip screen names the schedule.** The trip you are on now says
  which run it is — "Morning Pickup", "Afternoon Drop Off" — under the Pickup
  or Drop Off heading, so a bus doing two runs is not one glance away from
  confusion.

- **The end of a trip gives you a summary.** After ending a trip you now see
  which run it was, when it started and ended, how long it took, and how many
  children were picked up or dropped off and how many were absent.

- **The app download is about a third of the size.** Around 20MB instead of
  58MB, so an update over mobile data finishes far sooner.
- **Test update.** This update has no new features or fixes, it is just a test of the update system.

- **The walkthrough lets you practise scanning for real.** The guided tour's
  roll call used to arrive with every child already marked present, so the one
  thing you do on that screen every afternoon — hold a tag against the phone —
  was the one thing it never showed you. Now it starts empty, like the real
  screen. Hold any student tag against the phone and it reads, including the
  cards you already carry, which the tour used to turn away as not registered
  to a student on this trip. No tag to hand? Tap "Skip" in the top corner.
  Either way all three children on the practice trip are marked present and
  the tour carries on. Nothing about a real roll call changes.

- **Times are right again, on the phone and on the dashboard.** A student
  marked absent showed a time three hours into the future, and pickups and
  drop-offs arrived on the dashboard three hours early. Both were the same
  mistake, in opposite directions. Every time the app shows you, and every
  time it records, is now the time on your phone.
- **Fixed the scanner not working when a drop-off starts.** After taking roll
  call by scanning tags, the pickup/drop-off screen would not read a tag until
  you left the screen and came back. The roll call screen was releasing the
  reader on its way out, after the next screen had already picked it up.
- **The walkthrough now teaches the scanning roll call.** The drop-off part of
  the guided tour used to send you out to the manual list, which is not the
  screen you actually use. It stays on the scanning screen now: everyone
  starts marked present — the tour's tags are not real — and you tap a child
  to mark them absent, then confirm.

- **The bus now reports its position on the map more often.** While a trip is
  running the app sends its location every 15 seconds, rather than only after
  the bus has moved or once every few minutes. Positions taken where there is
  no signal are held on the phone and sent when signal comes back, so a
  stretch of road with no coverage no longer leaves a gap. Nothing changes on
  screen and nothing is needed from you.

- **Trip times were three hours early.** A trip you prepared at 09:05 showed
  06:05 on its card, and every other time in the app was out by the same
  amount. Times now read correctly.
- **A finished trip offers to end itself.** On a drop-off it asks once the last
  student is off the bus; on a pickup it waits until you are back at the
  school. There is a countdown you can stop to keep the trip open — nothing
  ends without giving you the chance to say no.
- **Scanning a tag that is not on today's run now names the student.** If the
  card belongs to a child at your school, the app says who it is and offers to
  add them to the trip and mark them collected in one tap, instead of only
  telling you the card was not on the list.
- **Trip cards show how many students are on the run**, and how many of them
  someone has reported absent.
- **Absences reported by someone else are shown before you set off**, not when
  you get to the stop. Starting a trip texts every guardian, so the moment
  before is the last one where this costs nothing. If there is nothing to
  report you will not see it.
- **Roll call: search for a student and tick them off by hand** when a tag will
  not read — without leaving the scanner and losing the scans you have already
  taken.
- **"Manual Roll Call" now only appears at schools still handing tags out.**
  Everywhere else the scanner, plus searching and ticking, is the whole of it.
- **Fixed "incident template not found" when reporting an incident.** Report
  Incident now offers six built-in types — Breakdown, Delay, Mechanical Issue,
  Traffic, Accident and Other — each with a sample sentence you can edit before
  sending. It needs nothing downloaded first, so it works with no signal. The
  screen no longer tells you in advance whether guardians will be texted; the
  confirmation afterwards says what actually happened.
- **Privacy Policy opens.** It opens inside the app rather than doing nothing,
  and tells you if it cannot. Terms & Conditions and Help & Support are hidden
  until they have somewhere to go.

- **The app walkthrough no longer loses its place.** The tour used to stop
  explaining itself part-way through: it would highlight a button hidden behind
  a pop-up, or point at something on a screen you had not reached yet and then
  quietly disappear. It now walks you through the trip-created message, the roll
  call scanning screen, and each step of assigning and checking a tag.
- **Changing your password works again.** The app was sending the request to the
  wrong address.

- **You can undo a pickup or drop-off.** The app no longer asks "are you sure?"
  for every student — one tap moves them to the completed list. For 30 seconds
  after that you can take it back: tap **UNDO** on the message at the bottom of
  the screen, or tap the ring on the student's row. Nothing is sent to the
  office and no parent is texted until those 30 seconds are up, so an undo
  leaves no trace.
- **Weak signal no longer loses a student.** If a pickup cannot be saved the
  app keeps trying for a few seconds before it tells you. Anyone it still could
  not save comes back to the pending list with a message naming them, so you
  know exactly who to redo.
- **Scanning a tag for someone already done now says so**, by name, instead of
  telling you the tag is not registered.
- **You can tick a student off by name during tag roll call.** Search the list
  on the scanning screen and tap the student. A tag that will not read no
  longer sends you back to the manual screen and loses the scans you have
  already taken. Pressing back closes the search first, so you cannot leave the
  roll call by accident.
- **The refresh button on the Tags screen now waits a minute between refreshes**
  and shows a countdown ring while it does. Tapping it early tells you it is
  already up to date.
- **The bus only reports its position when it has actually moved**, which uses
  less of your data. While parked it still checks in every 3 minutes, so
  anyone following the bus can tell the tracking is alive.

- **Report Incident works again.** Tapping it now opens straight away instead of
  sometimes doing nothing for a few seconds.
- **You can change your own password.** Open **Profile** and tap **Change
  Password**. There is no code by SMS — enter your current password, then your
  new one twice.
- **Check a trip before you start it.** Tap a prepared trip to see the students
  on it. Starting a trip texts every parent that the bus is on its way, so you
  no longer have to start one just to see who is on the run. **Start** is still
  its own button on the card.
- **The bus reports its position every 15 seconds** while a trip is running,
  instead of once a minute, so parents following the bus see it moving.
